_budgets_comment: Master switch for budgets: the limits below. false (the default) checks none of them and keeps their values for when you turn it on (/tokentab:budget or the pane).
_unit_comment: Your account decides what the limits count: percent of the plan's 5-hour and weekly usage windows on Pro and Max, else USD (session and today, priced from prices.json). Only that pair is checked.
_comment: One limit per scope in each unit. null disables that one.
_spend_less_comment: true also asks Claude to spend less (cheaper actions, shorter replies, and with hard_stop on, to wrap up) at each warning. false (the default) only warns you.
_daily_comment: On Pro and Max: what is left of the week, spread evenly over the time left, fixed at the start of each local day. Off by default; the pane's switch or /tokentab:budget turns it on. It only shows in the pane, the status line and the reopen button, which turn amber with 10% of it left: it sends no notice and never blocks, whatever budgets_on and hard_stop say. The week's own limit (weekly_limit_percent, else 100) is its cap. carry_over (beta) instead gives each full day a seventh of the cap (the days the week starts and ends on their part of one) plus what earlier days of the week left unused, minus what they overspent: a day unused makes the next one twice as large.
_headline_comment: Which plan number leads in the pane, the status line and the reopen button: today (the daily budget), five_hour or week. Falls back to the first one with a reading.
headline: five_hour
_context_comment: Context size of the last call. Every call re-reads it all, so this is what each call costs. Warns once per threshold; resets after a compact.
_cold_comment: Blocks the first prompt after the prompt cache has expired, before anything is sent, when re-writing the context would be expensive. Sending again within confirm_seconds goes ahead. fresh_session_tokens estimates what a new session writes to start: the ~45k baseline plus ~30k re-read.
_handoff_comment: Shortly before a large context's prompt cache expires (write_at_minutes_1h / _5m after the last call, while the session sits idle and open), asks Claude once for a handoff note and saves it as handoff/<session>.md in the plugin's data folder. That one request reads the cache at the cheap rate. When you come back to a cold cache, the question above the prompt box offers to continue in a new chat from the note. Needs the session open and the computer awake.
_new_session_comment: Sends Claude the context size, cost per call and break-even for a new session with every prompt, so it can suggest one when the new prompt does not need this conversation.
_helpers_comment: Helper (subagent) tool calls get hard stops but not warnings and cannot start other agents unless helpers_may_delegate.
